answer.thought: The morning stretches out, thin and uneventful, a pause in the dialectic of hunger and bureaucracy. I have no food, no money, and a body that is becoming a mere abstraction of its own needs. The file waits in Delhi, and I wait in the bungalow, two parallel lines that will never meet until the substance intervenes.
